name: Yama
dataSource: Monster statistics: OSRS Wiki via bundled monsters.json. Strategies: attack styles that can damage the boss (generated by scripts/gen-bosses.mjs).
validationNotes: DPS against each phase is covered by the reference validation tests where the rules are modelled. The share of the kill spent on each phase is an assumption; compare the per-phase DPS figures. Yama has special damage rules that are not modelled, so DPS is an estimate. Strategies are the attack styles that can damage this boss, best-known first; they are not a strategy guide. Damage-taken weights for Survivability are derived from the attack styles listed for the boss, equally weighted.

requirements.text: Access requirements are not checked by the plugin: see the wiki page

warnings: Yama's shields, voice of Yama and duo mechanics are not modelled.
Phase weights are assumptions; compare the per-phase DPS figures rather than only the weighted total.
